notes.after: ; and I fasted and prayed before the God
notes.text: The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “ אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).
When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “ יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

notes.after: s, and its bars, and one thousand cubits
notes.text: A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

notes.after: our children as their children. Behold,
notes.text: “Behold”, from “ הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

notes.text: A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.
